correctness.rationale: Direct substitution into each of two exact inverse branches proves invariant area and the Perron images of both centered coordinates. Exact triangular integration gives the covariance at zero and geometric recurrence gives all positive lags, which are absolutely summable. Branch cylinders generate a fair Bernoulli shift, establishing ergodicity. The bounded reverse-martingale differences have conditional variance averaging to 1/6, and the martingale CLT proves the nondegenerate x-coordinate limit. The exact all-point coboundary x-3y=H-H∘T with 0≤H≤2 gives the bivariate degenerate limit, uniqueness of the null direction, and sharpness at (2,0). A local exact symbolic checker verified all finite identities, but does not purport to replace infinite arguments.

value.rationale: The published triangular family is already studied for physical measures, entropy and statistical stability, making coordinate sums and covariance natural dynamical invariants. Despite a two-dimensional invariant density, two positive Lyapunov exponents, and full-branch mixing, the bivariate coordinate fluctuations collapse onto a one-dimensional Gaussian; exactly one linear direction exhibits uniformly bounded orbit-sum discrepancy. The full lag sequence, exact Green--Kubo nullspace and sharp global bound are motivated structural information that density/entropy alone cannot recover. The result is confined to a natural canonical endpoint, not an arbitrary arithmetic slice.
